Players Committee card image of [[Evil Is Everywhere]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on table. Non-[Episode I] Dark Jedi are lost. Unless with Obi-Wan, Dooku is immune to attrition. Your game text on Jedi Council Chamber is canceled. Once per turn, may ▼ a mobile hallway or [Episode I] lightsaber. [Immune to Alter.]” Uploaded unchanged.
